assessment: The plasticity and heterogeneity of fibroblasts in the tumor microenvironment of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) has emerged as a key factor in determining tumor growth and therapeutic response. Here the authors use innovative approaches to combine spatial profiling with single cell transcriptomics to define tumor-proximal populations of fibroblasts that predict clinical outcome. Specifically, elevated expression of HIF-1a and podoplanin predicted worse outcome while inflammatory gene expression correlated with increased survival, suggesting future interventions targeting proximal fibroblast populations to mitigate against PDAC.
